description: Estimated tax safe harbor — US federal quarterly estimated tax planner (Form 1040-ES / 2210). expected_tax= this year's total tax; optional prior_year_tax= and prior_year_agi= (100% vs 110% safe harbor over $150k, $75k MFS), withholding= (treated as paid evenly), filing_status=single|mfj|mfs|hoh|qss, tax_year=, farmer=1 (66 2/3% rule, single Jan 15 payment). Returns the required annual payment and which test sets it, the $1,000 rule, each due date rolled past weekends, MLK Day and DC Emancipation Day, the suggested payment per quarter, next due date and verdict. paid=Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4 amounts adds an underpayment penalty estimate (regular method, rate= % default 7). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_estimated_tax
